target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Primary municipal government managing downtown parking, street parking regulations, and parking ordinances. Located on Lake Erie's coastline between Cleveland, OH and Erie, PA. City name 'Ashtabula' comes from Algonquin Indian term 'Hush-tah-buh-lah' meaning 'River of many fish.' Digital parking management would streamline enforcement and payment collection for the city's parking infrastructure. Mission: provide service and partner with citizens, businesses and neighbors to enhance quality of life.

target_buyer_2.organization: Ashtabula Downtown Partnership / Harbor District Businesses
target_buyer_2.note: Research identified technology vendors (TIBA, Propark) as leads, but secondary LOCAL buyer requires additional research. Downtown businesses and Harbor District establishments would benefit from shared parking solutions. Recommend follow-up research to identify specific business association or downtown development entity.
